subtitle.text: 4 real videos that'll actually teach you

videos.title: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners
videos.description: freeCodeCamp's most watched python video. covers every core basic, lists, loops, functions, classes, and builds a calculator, mad libs game and guessing game as you go.

videos.title: Python for Beginners - Full Course
videos.description: mosh hamedani's beginner course. clean and structured, one of the most recommended first python videos if you've genuinely never coded before.

videos.title: The Complete Python Course For Beginners
videos.description: tech with tim takes you from zero syntax to actually building projects, so you're writing real programs instead of just watching someone else type.

videos.title: Python OOP Tutorial 1: Classes and Instances
videos.description: corey schafer's oop series is the one almost every intermediate python dev eventually watches. once you know the basics this is where you actually get good.
